historically.en: Historically, the discipline has been dominated by a small number of research groups.
historically.zh: 从历史角度看，该学科长期由少数几个研究小组主导。

historically.en: The manuscript situates the reform historically, tracing its roots to earlier administrative practice.
historically.zh: 该手稿从历史维度为这场改革定位，追溯其早期行政实践的根源。

historically.en: Such patterns have historically recurred whenever fiscal pressure weakened local oversight capacity.
historically.zh: 每当财政压力削弱地方监督能力时，此类现象在历史上都会反复出现。

critically.en: The review critically assesses the assumptions underlying the dominant theoretical framework.
critically.zh: 该述评批判性地审视了主流理论框架背后的基本假设。

critically.en: The housing subsidy is critically important for low-income households in rural districts.
critically.zh: 住房补贴对农村地区的低收入家庭而言至关重要。

critically.en: Data drawn from self-reported diaries should be interpreted critically because of systematic bias.
critically.zh: 源自自我报告日记的数据存在系统性偏差，因而应加以审慎解读。

mathematically.en: The result can be proved mathematically, although its interpretation remains philosophically contested.
mathematically.zh: 该结论可在数学上得到证明，尽管其解释在学理上仍存争议。

mathematically.en: Mathematically, the growth rate equals the sum of the component rates over the same period.
mathematically.zh: 在数学上，增长率等于同一时期各分项增长率之和。

mathematically.en: It is mathematically possible to model the diffusion process as a simple random walk.
mathematically.zh: 在数学上，扩散过程可被建模为简单的随机游走。

logically.en: The two sections of the report logically follow from the assumptions stated in the introduction.
logically.zh: 报告的两个部分在逻辑上均由导言中所述假设推出。

logically.en: A logically consistent argument must address every premise on which its conclusion depends.
logically.zh: 逻辑自洽的论证必须回应其结论所依赖的每一项前提。

logically.en: Such a policy is logically inconsistent with the stated objective of reducing regional inequality.
logically.zh: 此类政策与缩小地区差距的既定目标在逻辑上并不一致。

culturally.en: The findings are culturally specific and cannot be generalized without further comparative evidence.
culturally.zh: 这些发现具有文化特异性，若无进一步比较证据则无法推广。

culturally.en: Culturally, the community regarded the festival as a marker of collective identity.
culturally.zh: 从文化上看，该社群将该节庆视为集体身份的标志。

culturally.en: Such practices remain culturally significant even after their economic function has disappeared.
culturally.zh: 即便其经济功能已经消失，此类实践仍然具有重要的文化意义。

previously.en: Previously unpublished correspondence substantially revises the accepted chronology of the reform.
previously.zh: 此前未公开的往来书信实质上修正了人们所接受的改革时间顺序。

previously.en: The institute previously employed a larger staff before the budget was restructured.
previously.zh: 在预算重组之前，该研究所的雇员规模更大。

previously.en: Estimates previously reported for the northern provinces have since been revised downward.
previously.zh: 先前报告的北部省份估计数值此后已被下调。

immediately.en: The committee immediately suspended the license pending an independent review of the records.
immediately.zh: 委员会立即暂停了该项许可，等待对档案进行独立审查。

immediately.en: Such reminders immediately reduce the incidence of duplicate submissions in online forms.
immediately.zh: 此类提示可立即减少在线表单中重复提交的情形。

immediately.en: The amendment immediately altered the eligibility criteria for admission to the program.
immediately.zh: 修正案立即改变了该项目的入学资格标准。

already.en: The preliminary results already suggest a substantial decline in reported infections.
already.zh: 初步结果已经显示出所报告的感染人数大幅下降。

already.en: Several theoretical objections to the framework have already been articulated in the literature.
already.zh: 针对该框架的若干理论异议早已在文献中得到阐述。

already.en: The revised edition already incorporates the errata circulated among contributing authors.
already.zh: 修订版已经纳入了各撰稿人之间流传的勘误。

suddenly.en: The decline in enrollment suddenly reversed after the new admission criteria took effect.
suddenly.zh: 在新的录取标准生效之后，入学人数的下降突然逆转。

suddenly.en: Publication in a leading journal suddenly raised the visibility of the paper within the field.
suddenly.zh: 在权威期刊上发表论文突然提高了该文在本领域的可见度。

suddenly.en: The apparent stability of the series suddenly collapsed once the measurement error was corrected.
suddenly.zh: 在测量误差得到校正之后，该序列表面的稳定突然崩塌。

slowly.en: Structural change in employment tends to occur slowly and becomes visible only in aggregate data.
slowly.zh: 就业结构的变迁往往缓慢发生，只有在汇总数据中才可见。

slowly.en: The sediment record indicates that the lake filled slowly over many centuries.
slowly.zh: 沉积记录表明，该湖是在许多世纪中缓慢淤积而成。

slowly.en: Regulatory agencies slowly adjusted their requirements as the pattern of regional decline became clearer.
slowly.zh: 随着地区衰退的格局日渐清晰，监管机构缓慢地调整了监管要求。

temporarily.en: The dataset was temporarily withdrawn while an inconsistency in the coding scheme was corrected.
temporarily.zh: 在编码方案的一处不一致得到纠正之前，数据集被暂时撤下。

temporarily.en: Hospitals temporarily reduced elective admissions in order to preserve capacity for emergency care.
temporarily.zh: 各医院暂时削减了选择性收治，以保留应急救治所需的收治能力。

temporarily.en: The reading room was temporarily closed while the damaged catalog was restored.
temporarily.zh: 受损的目录得到修复期间，阅览室被暂时关闭。

indefinitely.en: The grant was renewed indefinitely, which weakened the incentive to seek alternative sources of support.
indefinitely.zh: 该资助被无限期地续拨，这削弱了寻求其他支持来源的激励。

indefinitely.en: Such arrangements cannot be maintained indefinitely without eroding the quality of teaching.
indefinitely.zh: 若不牺牲教学质量，此类安排不可能无限期维持下去。

indefinitely.en: The mandate allows the agency to extend the program indefinitely without any parliamentary review.
indefinitely.zh: 该授权允许该机构无需议会审议即可无限期延长项目期限。

continuously.en: The sensors continuously record temperature and salinity throughout the water column.
continuously.zh: 传感器沿整个水柱持续记录温度与盐度。

continuously.en: Continuously rising costs have eroded the competitiveness of the manufacturing sector.
continuously.zh: 成本的持续上升削弱了制造业部门的竞争力。

continuously.en: The model was continuously updated as new observations became available from the monitoring network.
continuously.zh: 随着监测网络提供新的观测数据，该模型被持续更新。
